title: M5 stage26: exact anchored single-block arithmetic count
scope: Bridge n to anchored polynomial divisibility before forming the two-block C formula. Size k selects k positive positions; anchored weight is k+1.

spec.name: M5.AnchoredCount.anchor_polynomial
spec.statement: ∀ U : Finset ℕ, 0 ∉ U → M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport (insert 0 U) = 1 + M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport U
spec.guidance: Unfold ofSupport and use Finset.sum_insert with 0 not in U; X^0=1. Return only tactic lines without leading by. Keep the exact target.

spec.name: M5.AnchoredCount.anchor_divisibility
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (U : Finset ℕ), 0 ∉ U → (P ∣ M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport (insert 0 U) ↔ AdjoinRoot.mk P (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport U) = 1)
spec.guidance: Use anchor_polynomial. AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero identifies divisibility. Ring hom preserves 1+sum and the quotient has characteristic two, so 1+x=0 iff x=1. Do not add monicity or irreducibility; quotient identity holds for all P. Return only tactic lines without leading by. Keep the exact target.

spec.name: M5.AnchoredCount.anchored_single_block_count
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (W : Finset ℕ) (k : ℕ), 0 ∉ W → M5.ArithmeticSubset.n P hP W k 1 = (M5.AnchoredCount.count P W k : ℤ)
spec.guidance: Rewrite M5.ArithmeticSubset.n_exact. Every U in W.powersetCard k is a subset of W, hence avoids zero. Apply anchor_divisibility to equate the filters. No premise k<=W.card is needed; impossible sizes count zero. Return only tactic lines without leading by. Keep the exact target. Unfold M5.AnchoredCount.count with classical decidability.
